title: Taking Busking to the Next Level
what_it_is: Taking Busking to the Next Level

sections.label: Local artist and busker
sections.summary: A local artist and busker who was genuinely nice passed away on 10 March this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: There are some people whom you meet for the first time and you immediately know that they are nice people, genuinely nice.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: She is a local artist and busker and passed away on 10 March this year.

sections.label: Wheelchair and busking areas
sections.summary: It was especially difficult when Yu Xuan was in a wheelchair, and they hope for five busking areas with a few sites each.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It was especially difficult when Yu Xuan was in a wheelchair.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: They hope that instead of five busking sites, it can be five busking areas and, in each area, have a few busking sites.

sections.label: Ballot for busking hotspots
sections.summary: One suggestion is to have a ballot system for selected busking hotspots.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: One suggestion he has is to have a ballot system for selected busking hotspots.

sections.label: Balloting at Ngee Ann City
sections.summary: Balloting gives everyone a fair chance at hotspots and the public a range of performances, suggested for Ngee Ann City and Clarke Quay.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Having a balloting system means that everyone will have a fair chance to busk at these hotspots instead of just a few buskers, and the public will be able to see a range of performances instead of only the few who had "choped" the spots.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I suggest we implement this for the busking sites in front of Ngee Ann City and at Clarke Quay for a start.

sections.label: Buskers Association registration
sections.summary: Jonathon started the Singapore Buskers Facebook group, and he and fellow buskers will register a Buskers Association working with NAC and supported by Timbre.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: He started a Facebook group called Singapore Buskers, with the aim of making the busking community more closely knitted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: He wants to take it one step further and I am delighted to share that Jonathon, together with fellow buskers Fadhil, Yong Kang, Benjamin, Fridaus and Marcus, will register a Buskers Association that will help take busking to the next level in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The association will work closely with NAC and will also be supported by Timbre.

sections.label: New Nee Soon East busking sites
sections.summary: Two new busking sites are planned in Nee Soon East, at Yishun Park Hawker Centre and Oasis Waterpark, also a testbed for balloting.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In addition to the current site at Yishun Park, I am planning to have two new busking sites in Nee Soon East: one at the Yishun Park Hawker Centre and the other at our brand-new Oasis Waterpark @ Nee Soon East.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The area will also be a testbed for the balloting system for busking.

sections.label: Endorsed buskers under Busking Scheme
sections.summary: There are about 300 endorsed buskers under the Busking Scheme, with one in two below age 35.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Currently, there are about 300 endorsed buskers under the Busking Scheme, with one in two buskers below the age of 35.

sections.label: Busking locations across Singapore
sections.summary: Busking locations grew from three at the scheme's start to 81 across Singapore, including Suntec City and Downtown East.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Where there had only been three locations when the Busking Scheme was first started, there are now 81 locations across Singapore for busking, from Suntec City and Tanjong Pagar to Lot One and Downtown East.

sections.label: NAC trial with Louis Ng
sections.summary: NAC will work with Mr Louis Ng to trial allocation mechanisms such as balloting and designated sites in Nee Soon East Division.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: NAC will be happy to work with Mr Louis Ng to trial allocation mechanisms, such as balloting and the designation of sites for busking, in his Nee Soon East Division.

sections.label: NAC engaging Busking Association
sections.summary: NAC is engaging the new Busking Association to co-create and co-develop a code of practice for the busking community.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: NAC is already engaging the new Busking Association to co-create and co-develop a code of practice for our busking community.
